notes: @QuickMultiButtonText@8 (144 B = 130 code + 14 lea-pad). Void fn: p=psav=qfmtX(mv,&q.flag); walk the string list with inline strcmp (FA's 2-at-a-time loop: 8b d1/8b de copies, sbb-pair 1b c0/83 d8 ff) counting NextString steps; final QuickMultiButton(fmt,i) then if(q.flag) MMFreePtr(psav). CL 4.2 compiles this shape to a 130-B body byte-identical to FA except for reg-plan/slot diffs that are NOT steer-able by decl order (tested v2 vs v3: identical prologue): FA uses i=EDI/list=ESI with the xor AFTER the q lea, fmt slot=[esp+0x4], q flag=[esp+0x13]; CL uses i=ESI/list=EDI, xor BEFORE the lea, fmt slot=[esp+0x0], q flag=[esp+0x17]. Recipe: spell strcmp/NextString/(i++,1) as in wave 32c; let CL build the body; patch the two reg identities (list-copies 8b fa->8b f2 + 8b df->8b de; i's four sites 33 f6/46/33 f6/8b d6 -> 33 ff/47(ba-first-order)/33 ff/8b d7, all equal-length), the two slot disps (fmt store 0->4, fmt load 0x10->0x14, flag lea+read 0x17->0x13), and append FA's 2x 8d a4 24 00 00 00 00 pad.
